title: Concept: Dependency declared with a wildcard minor
description: package.json declares an `N.*` minor wildcard, which accepts every minor and patch release of that major, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The wildcard hides which release the build actually used, and a newly published minor is picked up on the next install without review.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: The wildcard hides which release the build actually used, and a newly published minor is picked up on the next install without review.
